mass: Positive lumped GLL quadrature for normalized uniform dry-reference measure ds dzeta; not evolving wet-volume weights.
method: Tensor P3 GLL mass-lumped weak form; 4/R^2 radial s-weighted stiffness and 1/(H0^2 ell^2) axial stiffness.
boundary: Side -2 h/R times axial edge mass; end -h/(H0 ell) times radial edge mass; centre and symmetry plane natural zero flux.
continuous_extrema: Outward interval Bernstein bounds of each continuous bicubic field, not nodal maximum; precision of this polynomial bound is distinct from PDE discretization error.
not_claimed: No completed nonlinear long-time 2D production comparison.
No general discrete maximum principle for cubic elements.
No certified error bound against the nonlinear continuous PDE.
No experimental validation of axial shrinkage.
field_storage: 全场数组由 reproduce_numerics.py mms --out 在指定工作目录生成；本目录保存每例参数、误差和验收摘要。
